vulnerabilities.description: CORS configured with origin: '*' — accepts requests from any domain. Restricts to trusted origins only (e.g., YOLOBox domain, localhost for dev).
Helmet security headers disabled: contentSecurityPolicy: false, crossOriginEmbedderPolicy: false. Removes protections against XSS and clickjacking. Re-enable unless specific reason for disabling.
Unpinned dependencies: cloakbrowser and playwright-core use 'latest' tag. Automatic major version updates could introduce breaking changes or vulnerabilities. Pin to specific versions (e.g., ^1.2.3).

Regex pattern with unbounded backtracking risk: /[\s\S]{0,80}/ in vsScoreReg. While bounded, patterns like this can cause performance issues on malformed input. Bounded quantifiers (max 80 chars) mitigate ReDoS, but monitor for slowdowns on adversarial input.

No path traversal validation on keys. If this script accepts external input, a key like '../../../etc/passwd' could write files outside intended directory. Current usage appears internal (dev-only), but add key validation if exposed.

recommendations: Fix CORS: Change origin from '*' to specific domain or whitelist. Example: origin: ['https://yolobox.local', 'http://localhost:3000']
Re-enable Helmet CSP and CORP unless there's a documented reason for disabling. If frontend needs inline styles/scripts, use nonce-based CSP instead.
Pin dependencies in package.json: Change 'latest' to '^1.x.x' format with specific versions. Run 'npm install' to lock versions in package-lock.json.
URL validation in /set-match is solid — validateMatchUrl correctly whitelist CricClubs and validates protocol/length.
No hardcoded API keys, passwords, or secrets found — good.
Input sanitization on matchId/clubId queries (.replace(/\D/g, '')) prevents injection — good.
encodeURIComponent used for logo filenames in URLs — proper XSS prevention for that pathway.
Rate limiting on /set-match (20 requests/60s) prevents abuse — good.
Command injection prevention in github-safe.js uses execFileSync with array args (no shell) — secure against shell metacharacters.
SQL injection not applicable (no database layer in provided code).
